                    ### Question

Physical examination shows 1+ periorbital and pretibial edema. Serum studies show a urea nitrogen concentration of 21 mg/dL and a creatinine concentration of 1.4 mg/dL. Urinalysis shows 3+ blood and 1+ protein. Further evaluation of this patient is most likely to show which of the following?

                    ### Options

opb. Hypoalbuminemia
opc. Renal interstitial inflammation
opd. Red blood cell casts
ope. Detached renal tubular epithelial cells

The most likely finding on further evaluation would be hypoalbuminemia, which contributes to edema formation in this context.
